modelPlan.focus: Analyze the impact of over-competitiveness on individuals and society, presenting both advantages and disadvantages.
keyArguments: Over-competitive individuals may achieve personal success but at the cost of personal well-being and social relationships.
While competition can drive progress, an over-competitive environment can lead to negative societal outcomes such as increased stress and social stratification.

plan.focus: Analyze the impact of over-competitiveness on individuals and society, presenting both advantages and disadvantages.
keyArguments: Over-competitive individuals may achieve personal success but at the cost of personal well-being and social relationships.
While competition can drive progress, an over-competitive environment can lead to negative societal outcomes such as increased stress and social stratification.
